operation.description: Real gateway text/function generation frontend. Admission checks live key, workspace, model and provider capabilities. Default root body cap is fixed 2097152 bytes: declared Content-Length above it is rejected before decoding; Messages uses Anthropic errors, other routes plain text. Unknown fields are 400 invalid_request_error. Usage counters are emitted only when known; Messages message_start input_tokens:0 is a compatibility placeholder, never accounting. Native-only fields and translated-route refusals are described below.

200.description: JSON completion or ordered SSE. Errors after opening a stream are terminal error frames, never fabricated successful termination.

ordered: zero or more content/tool/finish/optional requested usage chunks
one [DONE], or final OpenAI error without [DONE]

x-omg-refusals.trigger: unknown fields, invalid types, bounds, malformed JSON or unsupported request field
unequal non-null max_tokens and max_completion_tokens, n other than 1, non-null refusal or unsupported message/tool shape
no configured deployment supports requested capability
